subject: ACE registration + PDM/PSM pairing — CloudOps opportunity
messages:
From: Sandeep Rao <sandeep@cloudops.io>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajesh Singh <rajesh@cloudops.io>
Date: 2027-08-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Intro — ACE registration for CloudOps

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks for the quick intro via the marketplace form — CloudOps is excited to pursue AWS ACE. We have a near-term opportunity with a national healthcare data partner (details below) and want to get ACE registration started so we can co-sell.

As next steps we need:
- ACE intake registration help / intake checklist
- PDM and PSM intros at Redwood so we can align on technical readiness and engagement model
- High-level timeline for ACE acceptance and any marketplace listing prerequisites (billing/legal readiness, listing assets)

Attached is a one-pager on the opportunity and customer persona (CloudOps_Opportunity_OnePager.pptx). Our AWS contact is Natalie Park (cc'd on this thread) and our internal lead is Rajesh Singh.

Can you advise availability for a 30–45 minute alignment call this week?

Thanks,
Sandeep Rao
Head of Partnerships
CloudOps Inc.
[sent from mobile]

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Sandeep Rao <sandeep@cloudops.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-22T10:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro — ACE registration for CloudOps

Hi Sandeep — great to meet you. Welcome, and thanks for the one-pager.

I'll coordinate the ACE intake; looping in the right Redwood leads:
- Marissa Cole (PDM) — will own partner motion and placement requirements
- Karthik Iyer (PSM) — will own the technical/enablement plan for the opportunity

Quick proposed plan:
1) PDM/PSM intro call (30–45m) to review opportunity, required AWS artifacts, and marketplace listing gaps
2) Share ACE intake checklist and list of assets (logos, one-pager, datasheet, listing copy) — see attached ace_checklist.pdf
3) Redwood + CloudOps produce a short mutual action plan and target ACE submission date (we suggest 2 weeks if assets are ready)

Are you available Thu 8/24 10:00–11:00 PT or Thu 8/24 14:00–15:00 PT? If those don't work, propose two windows and we'll accommodate.

I'll also confirm the AWS ACE contact and whether Natalie needs to be part of the intro call.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Head of Marketplace Partnerships | Redwood Inference
_evelyn_hart@redwood.com_

Attachments referenced: ace_checklist.pdf

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Sandeep Rao <sandeep@cloudops.io>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-23T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ACE registration — technical prerequisites / Marketplace readiness

Hi team,

Looping in a couple quick technical asks from the marketplace/market-readiness side:
- AWS Account IDs and CloudOps Partner/Alias ID (needed for ACE intake form)
- Confirmation of the AMI/container artifact (are you planning to use AWS Marketplace container listing or bring-your-own AMI?)
- Any SOC2/infosec evidence we should include with the intake (we can help format)

Also, for listing copy: please share a short product summary (2–3 bullets) and any pricing model you expect to present (subscription vs usage). We can draft the initial listing copy and route through your legal for approval.

Happy to jump on call with Marissa/Karthik on Thu 8/24 at the 14:00 PT slot if that works for everyone.

—Jonas
Director, Cloud Integrations | Redwood Inference

Thanks everyone — Thu 8/24 14:00 PT works for us. Confirming attendees: Sandeep Rao, Rajesh Singh (CloudOps), Marissa Cole (Redwood PDM), Karthik Iyer (Redwood PSM), Jonas Weber (Redwood tech), and Natalie Park (AWS ACE) is tentative and will join if available.

Action items from CloudOps before the call:
- Share AWS account IDs and Partner ID (sending in separate secure email)
- Upload current SOC2 summary and any compliance docs to the shared Drive link
- Review the ace_checklist.pdf and confirm assets we already have vs. items we need help producing

We'll send a calendar invite for Thu 8/24 14:00–14:45 PT and the meeting notes will be attached after the call. Looking forward to aligning.

Best,
Sandeep Rao
Head of Partnerships, CloudOps Inc.
